attributes.title: Getting a new internal tool
attributes.brief: When a team needs a new internal tool, what's their default route today? That's the habit an AI app builder has to beat.
attributes.prompt: Last time your team needed a new internal tool, how did you mostly get it?
attributes.options:
Asked our engineers to build it
Bought or subscribed to a product
Built it ourselves in a no-code tool
Made do with a spreadsheet
Asked an AI to build it
Went without
